title: Not receiving on an even level

verses.t: At one time the Buddha was staying at Sāvatthī in the Jeta Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s Monastery. At that time the monks from the group of six received almsfood in a heap. … Almsfood is to be received at an even level. If a monk, out of disrespect, receives almsfood in a heap, he commits an offense of wrong conduct. if he is insane; if he is the first offender. The tenth training rule is finished. The third subchapter on hands on hips is finished.
“‘I will receive an even level of almsfood,’ this is how you should train.”
if it is unintentional; if he is not mindful; if he does not know; if there is an emergency;
